title: Diya Painting Workshop 2
summary: A Diya Painting Workshop was conducted at Smt. Madhukanta Gunvant Sheth English High School Jointly with Rotaract Club of M L Dahanukar College on 19 October 2026 for 150 students from Grades 5 to 10.
description: A Diya Painting Workshop was conducted at Smt. Madhukanta Gunvant Sheth English High School Jointly with Rotaract Club of M L Dahanukar College on 19 October 2026 for 150 students from Grades 5 to 10. The workshop was guided by Ms Tania Fatnani, a Master of Fine Arts graduate with extensive experience in art. Students painted diyas that will be lit during the school's Diwali celebrations. The school also presented some painted diyas to HRIL as a token of gratitude for the organisation's CSR initiative supporting aptitude testing. Two Rotaractors from M. L. Dahanukar College assisted with the activity. The workshop was sponsored by Director Rtn Namrata Nulwalla and attended by Director Bijal Merchant and Partner Dr Urvi Kothari.
location: Smt. Madhukanta Gunvant Sheth English High School, Mumbai, Maharashtra
